formulas.ascii: Retain first k valid neighbors, optionally exclude self, then sort IDs ascending in CSR. In inverse-distance mode q = 1 / max(distance, distanceFloor)^power; store q when q < 3e38, otherwise zero. Binary mode stores 1. No row standardisation.
